description: Corporate IT-styled notice tells staff to install a remote-access tool for an unsolicited outsourced caller, share the session password and approve an MFA prompt, by a same-day deadline.
rationale: Looks like routine IT, but an unsolicited call, a remote session, a request to approve someone else's MFA prompt and a same-day access-loss threat together indicate account takeover.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
